title: fix(cli): a flag given without its value (`os dev -d`) opens with the INVOCATION ERROR line
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XSSJD6C4GLhhpJrw1FTNZZn)_

Fixes #28931

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`os dev -d`、`os serve --port`、`os migrate meta --from` 这类「旗标没给值」的调用,现在和未知旗标一样,stderr 第一行先打出 `objectstack: INVOCATION ERROR — Flag --database expects a value. The command never ran: nothing was started and nothing is listening.`。同类的另外三种解析失败也一并补上:带选项列表的旗标没给值(`--log-level`)、单值旗标给了两次(`-p 1 -p 2`)、旗标自带解析拒收的值(`--eval-min abc`)。
- 为什么改:原来这几种只有 oclif 一行 `Error: Flag --database expects a value`,退出码 2。后台跑时看起来像服务起来又挂了,读的人会去排查一个从没启动过的应用。
- 风险与回滚:只改 stderr 首行;接受/拒收的输入、退出码 2、oclif 自己的后续行都不变。命令解析成功后在运行中失败的错误(`this.error()`)不加横幅,有正反两个测试钉住。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/cli/src/utils/invocation.ts` 的 `isInvocationError`(新增按抛出位置识别:错误自身栈里有 oclif 解析器模块的帧);`src/utils/invocation.test.ts` 新增的用例。
- 两分钟验证:在任一应用目录跑 `node packages/cli/bin/run.js dev -d`,预期退出码 2,stderr 第一行是 `objectstack: INVOCATION ERROR — Flag --database expects a value. ...`,下面仍是 oclif 原来那一行。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **`isInvocationError()` gains a second reading: the throw site.** oclif's parser throws a plain `CLIError` (no `parse` / `showHelp` own fields) for a flag given without its value, a single-valued flag given twice and a bare option-list flag, and passes a flag's own `parse` failure (`Flags.integer` on `abc`) through. Those errors carry nothing a runtime failure does not: a command that parsed and then called `this.error()` throws the same class, with the same own fields (`stack,message,code,oclif,skipOclifErrorHandling,suggestions`) and the same `oclif.exit` of 2 (measured, and pinned in the unit file). So the order's hypothesised readings (class / own fields / `oclif.exit`) cannot separate them. What differs is where the error was thrown: the predicate reads the error's own `stack` for a frame inside `@oclif/core/lib/parser/` (either path separator). A command body never runs with that module on the stack, because `this.parse()` has returned before it does. No English message text is matched.
- **The `CLIParseError` reading is unchanged** and still covers an unknown flag, a refused option value, a missing required flag, a missing required arg and an unexpected arg (all five measured printing the banner on `main` already).
- **Degrades towards silence.** A stack it cannot read (stack-trace limit 0, a moved parser module) answers false, which is the behaviour before this PR, never a banner on a runtime failure. A moved module is caught by the unit file, which throws every case through the real `Parser.parse`.
- **Unchanged:** which inputs are accepted or refused, the exit code (2), and oclif's own lines after the banner. No new flag.

## Tests

- **Unit, `packages/cli/src/utils/invocation.test.ts`:** recognised through the real parser: missing value (`-d`), bare option-list flag, flag given twice, `Flags.integer` refusal; missing required flag, missing required arg and unexpected arg kept recognised. Not claimed: a real oclif `Command` that parsed and then called `this.error()` (asserted to share class, own fields and `oclif.exit: 2` with the parse-time error), and a bare `Errors.error()`. `invocationFailureLine` names `Flag --database expects a value` for `dev -d` and returns `undefined` for the runtime command.
- **Spawn, `packages/cli/test/invocation-loudness.e2e.test.ts` (nightly e2e tier, already spawning `dev --no-ui`):** one more spawn, `dev -d`: exit 2, oclif's own line kept, the INVOCATION ERROR line first, stdout empty.

<details><summary>Measured on main (base 135054eb), built bin/run.js, from examples/app-todo</summary>

| invocation | exit | banner on main | banner on head |
|---|---|---|---|
| `dev --no-compile -p PORT -d` | 2 | no (`Error: Flag --database expects a value`) | yes |
| `serve --port` | 2 | no | yes |
| `migrate meta --from` | 2 | no | yes |
| `dev --no-compile --log-level` | 2 | no (`expects one of these values`) | yes |
| `dev --no-compile -p A -p B` | 2 | no (`can only be specified once`) | yes |
| `lint --eval-min abc` | 2 | no (`Parsing --eval-min` / `Expected an integer`) | yes |
| `plugin keygen` (missing required flag) | 2 | yes | yes |
| `plugin uninstall` (missing required arg) | 2 | yes | yes |
| `plugin uninstall a b` (unexpected arg) | 2 | yes | yes |
| `serve --artifact x` (nonexistent flag, control) | 2 | yes | yes |
| `dev --no-compile -p abc` (runtime refusal) | 1 | no | no |
| `plugin uninstall no-such-plugin` (runtime) | 1 | no | no |

Error shapes (real `Parser.parse` and a real `Command`): every parse-time plain error and the runtime `this.error()` are `CLIError`, own fields `stack,message,code,oclif,skipOclifErrorHandling,suggestions`, `oclif {"exit":2}`, `code undefined`. Parse-time stacks carry `@oclif/core/lib/parser/parse.js` frames; the runtime stack carries `lib/errors/error.js` and `lib/command.js` only.

</details>

<details><summary>Red on base, green on head, ablations</summary>

- Red (base source, new tests): unit `5 failed | 21 passed (26)`, the four parse-time recognitions and the `dev -d` line; the negatives pass on base. Spawn `1 failed | 13 passed (14)`, "puts the INVOCATION ERROR line FIRST on stderr".
- Green on head `45c1b2f0`: unit `26 passed (26)`; spawn `14 passed (14)`.
- Ablation 1 (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`: the throw-site reading forced false): unit `5 failed | 21 passed`, spawn `1 failed | 13 passed`, the same cases as red-first. Restored: blob `78901ca1` == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- Ablation 2, the negative pin (every `Error` claimed, the naive class/exit reading): unit `5 failed | 21 passed`, exactly the five runtime-not-claimed cases. Restored: blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- Both test files import `src/` (the spawn runs `bin/run-dev.js` under tsx), so no `dist/` leg; the head probe table above ran the rebuilt `bin/run.js`.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The banner's reason is the first line of oclif's message, so for a flag-parse refusal it reads `INVOCATION ERROR — Parsing --eval-min.` and for a missing required flag (unchanged from `main`) `INVOCATION ERROR — The following error occurred:.`; the actual reason is on oclif's lines right below. Left as is: `reasonOf()` is shared by every class and the order keeps this change to recognition.
- One more cold spawn in `invocation-loudness.e2e.test.ts` (five instead of four); the file is in the nightly e2e tier, not the PR queue.

## Verification

All at head `45c1b2f0`.

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`: 61 derived families. `--ran` reconciliation exit 0: **60 run, exit 0; 1 NOT MEASURED** (`check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exit 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET: needs every package's `dist/`; CI measures it). `check:i18n-coverage` first exited 3 (examples' plugin `dist/` absent), exit 0 after building the closure it names. `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` ran after `git fetch --depth=1` of its pinned fixture commit.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project unit`: `368 passed (368)` files, `5205 passed (5205)` tests (lock VERDICT command-exit 0). The integration tier is CI's; the one spawn file touched is nightly-tier and was run alone (`14 passed`).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli typecheck` (incl. `check:test-typecheck`): exit 0.
- eslint `--no-inline-config` over `packages/cli`: exit 0.
- CI check-runs: not waited on at hand-back; the seat reads them.
